description: Synthetic two-speaker IELTS Part 1 exchange, generated from Windows SAPI voices. Owned by this project; no third-party rights. Turn boundaries are exact because the timeline was constructed, not annotated.

turns.text: Good morning. Can you tell me about your hometown?
Yes, of course. I grew up in a small city in the Nile Delta. It is a fairly quiet place, and most of the families there have known each other for generations. I still live there with my parents.
And what do you do in your free time?
Well, I spend quite a lot of my free time reading, mostly history books. I also meet friends at a coffee shop near my house on Fridays, although recently I have been rather busy with work.
Do you think you will stay there in the future?
That is a difficult question. Honestly, I am not sure. I would like to stay close to my family, but the opportunities in my field are mostly in the capital, so I may have to move eventually.
